exposure: Erector spinae plane block (ESPB) with liposomal bupivacaine
outcome: Visual analog scale pain intensity scores (0-48h)
Need for treatment of postoperative nausea and vomiting and pruritus
cohort: Women undergoing elective cesarean delivery under spinal or combined spinal epidural anesthesia.
finding: Erector spinae plane block with liposomal bupivacaine did not reduce postoperative opioid consumption but was associated with reduced pain scores compared with historical controls.
